flags.estimate: Per-rotation pool: 6000, refilled at t0 + each BS2 entry, spent -100/-300 per proc
flags.reasoning: Kit says the fill is 'continuous and cannot be removed'. This may instead mean the pouch is CONTINUOUSLY auto-topped to 6000, in which case no proc is ever ammo-starved and the gates over-restrict (esp. the 50-hit proc and later charge-buff refreshes once >20 in-FB shots spend >6000).
flags.recipe: Watch a fight: does skill2's Charge-Damage buff ever lapse mid-FB, or does the 50-hit 400.92% proc fail to fire late in long FBs? If never starved → delete resources+gates, make all buffs unconditional.

flags.reasoning: Datamine rate_of_fire is unreliable and the swap economy is kit-silent. 7%/shot implies a rapid weapon; it must fire fast enough to (a) land 50 normals inside the 10s FB and (b) refresh skill2's 3s charge buff. Class drives auto-core rate; maxAmmo/reload drives shot count.
flags.recipe: Datamine the burst swap shot_id (fire rate, magazine, class) OR count her shots per burst window in footage; set pullsPerSec/weapon/maxAmmo accordingly.

flags.field: skill2[0].trigger (shotFired+fbGate:inFb) — 'Full Charge' identity of swap shots
flags.estimate: Swap-weapon shots each count as a Full Charge (so skill2 block1 fires during FB)
flags.reasoning: skill2's ally buff and the 50-normal counter both key off in-FB attacks. Velvet's base SR charges slowly; only the burst swap weapon can produce enough in-FB shots. Assumed the swap weapon fires full-charge shots. If it fires plain normals, block1 never triggers and Velvet's entire ally-support value disappears.
flags.recipe: Confirm in footage that ally Charge Damage / ATK buff icons apply during Velvet's own burst (i.e., her swap shots satisfy the 'Full Charge during FB' clause).

flags.estimate: count:50 with fbGate:'inFb' as a proxy for 'during Full Burst' only
flags.reasoning: Engine hitCount counts ALL cumulative hits; the kit counts only normals landed during FB. Approximated by fbGate (her rapid fire is FB-only via the swap), but out-of-FB base-SR shots would still increment the raw counter — over-counting could pull the proc earlier than real.
flags.recipe: Measure how often the 400.92% add'l-damage popup appears (per-FB vs per-N-FBs); if the engine can't restrict counting to FB, adjust count to match observed cadence.
